thread:
frank: quick sync on the 'rapid validation pods' for design partners. want a short, enforceable scope and clear acceptance gates so we don't overpromise. target: 10 partners, 6-week pods, mix hosted + private.

leila: Agree. My recommendation: define a 3-step acceptance gate: 1) integration smoke (sdk + auth) within 7 days, 2) perf visibility (p50/p95 + cost delta) by week2, 3) product validation (3 business scenarios exercised) by week5. Pass all -> recommended for pilot-to-prod.

sam: Ops note: private capacity limited. We can support 3 concurrent private pods and 1 hotfix slot reserved weekly. That implies waves of 3 with 1 backup.

maya: On measurements: add automated correctness checks (10 seed prompts) and a lightweight human review for edge cases. If automated pass rate < 90% open a mitigation ticket and trigger a rollback path.

frank: Good. Also want a "minimal observability" checklist partners must enable: request_id tracing, anonymized tokens, and per-request latency headers. We'll provide a small client snippet.

ops-bot: Reminder from infra: heavy quantization jobs should be scheduled off-peak. Recommend no quantization experiments in week1-2.

leila: For recruitment selector: prioritize partners who can commit a named integration lead and a weekly 30m sync. Split: 50% existing hosted, 30% on-prem interest, 20% strategic new. Reserve one slot for regulated customer pending legal.

sam: Incentives: credits + two engineering office hours per partner. For 3 partners we can include a small implementation grant (solutions time) to unblock infra work.

maya: Success metrics (short list): 1) integration kickoff <=7 days, 2) p95 hosted <=350ms, 3) avg partner satisfaction >=7/10, 4) at least 2 partners commit to roadmap items post-pilot.

legal-bot: Note: regulated partners require DPA + data-flow diagram before any private runs. Expect ~5 business days for review. Mark intake as "legal-awaiting".

frank: Scope negotiation: we should explicitly exclude large streaming workloads and high-throughput batch imports from wave1. We can allow sample streaming tests but not production streams. Add to intake exclusions.

leila: Also propose a short "stop/hold" rubric: pause new invites if >40% of active partners hit blocker status >72h or ops capacity falls below 60%.

sam: On reporting: weekly dashboard with integration status, perf, automated-test pass rate, and open-blocker counts. Product to own weekly summary; ops to maintain capacity view.

maya: Action items: frank -> publish one-pager with gates & exclusions (due EOD), leila -> update intake form and dashboard template (due Tue), sam -> reserve private wave slots + hotfix slot (due Tue), legal-bot -> confirm DPA turnaround and flag regulated candidate (ongoing).

frank: sweet. i'll draft and post to /product-recruit. keep it tight and explicit about time commitments. thanks all :rocket:
